references.text: Levi's sons Gershon, Kohath and Merari are also mentioned here when Jacob's family goes down to Egypt.
The same three sons of Levi - Gershon, Kohath and Merari - are mentioned in connection with the Levites' genealogy.
The Levite clans are mustered according to the three main lines: Gershon, Kohath and Merari.
Levi's sons Gershon, Kohath and Merari are listed in the genealogies of Chronicles.
David organizes the Levites according to the three main branches: Gershon, Kohath and Merari.
The birth and naming of Levi are described; he is the ancestor of the three sons mentioned in Exodus 6:16.
Direct continuation of the genealogy: Merari's sons Mahli and Mushi.
Expansion of Merari's line: Confirmation that his sons form a distinct Levitical clan.
Genealogical confirmation of the line through Merari back to Levi.
Genealogical confirmation of the line through Gershon back to Levi.
